title: Long Takes: Simultaneity and Duration (miközben, mialatt)
grammar: Simultaneity and parallel duration: miközben, mialatt, eközben
goal: I can depict simultaneous actions unfolding in parallel using miközben and mialatt.
I can contrast subordinate clauses (miközben) with coordinating discourse adverbs (eközben).
I can describe cinematic scenes with multiple layers of foreground and background action.
